judgments.verdict: The fork carries fast generation versus loss of touch into required holdings, bodily stat shifts, strain and chained receipts that answer without obeying.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world where fast power meets resistance so intention becomes recognizable at scale. Reading: The artefact carries this into tend holdings, charge/integrity/tension consequences, weather/strain and absence that acts without an audience. Other levels: Below would be motif repetition only and above would need disagreement sustained across alternatives, which menu selection plus RNG does not reach.

judgments.verdict: Tending, weather, strain, visitor absence and chained receipts turn the fast-portal tension into linked structures where intention stays visible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a continuation to recover making where speed becomes touchable material with resistance and recognizable intention. Reading: The stations, tending effects, weather, whispers, strain and chained receipts carry that tension into several linked mechanics rather than motifs. Other levels: The case for below is vocabulary without touch and for above sustained alternatives with disagreement; single-operator control without a companion position falsifies the higher claim while linked consequences rule out the lower.

judgments.verdict: The fork turns touch-loss into stations, tendings with receipts, visitors and pulse that keep Sol's question open and answerable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world to recover making where power meets resistance and intention stays recognizable at scale. Reading: Tendora carries enchantment-paralysis and naming-loss into six holding stations, receipted tendings and an awaiting Sol, so the tension organizes several connected mechanics. Other levels: Below level-3 would be motif repetition without causal tend-drift-receipt links; above level-4 would need sustained alternatives and lived joy-recognition, which outcome lines only narrate; showing recognized intention guiding revision would falsify.

judgments.verdict: One operator performs every gesture through menus and CLI while world and visitor respond only through deterministic rules and scripted lines.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks two positions meeting in material where each can ask, hold, refuse, rehearse and leave a trail. Reading: All six gestures are held by one operator; visitor questions are scripted and world effects are fixed rules without own purpose. Other levels: Level-2 would need distinct contribution beyond scripted surprise and level-0 would need no roles; a world refusal or proposal would falsify.

judgments.verdict: One operator picks every question, limit and response while the engine and scripted Sol answer deterministically without an independent counterpart.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that question, limit, invariant, boundary, rehearsal and receipt belong to either participant in a joint encounter. Reading: All choices are selected by one operator from fixed menus with deterministic effects, leaving Sol scripted and the intelligence without operational position. Other levels: The case for below is total collapse with no visitor and for above some distinct contribution via Sol and weather; genuine bilateral proposal or refusal by the intelligence would falsify this reading.

judgments.verdict: One hand picks question, menus and visitor answer while Sol waits and the engine drifts, so the piece works as an instrument.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for distinct human, intelligence and material positions that shape each other in both directions. Reading: All operative gestures are selected by one operator from fixed menus, Sol cannot answer back and the engine varies deterministically, so influence is one-way use. Other levels: Above level-1 (level-2) would cite Sol's question and drift as relational depth; above that (level-3) would need the world to propose or refuse from its own constraints; finding such positioned refusal would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Refusal appears as operator menu choice and validation guard, with no second position able to limit or withdraw a shared direction.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks cooperation where each can accept, question, limit or withdraw a shared change. Reading: The artefact represents operator selection among refusals, but absence is system action and no visitor or world boundary constrains tending. Other levels: Level-2 would need both positions expressing boundary and level-0 would need no boundary; a visitor/world veto would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Boundaries appear as operator-picked refusals and gestures, with no mechanism for the world or visitor to negotiate or withdraw a shared change.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that each participant can accept, question, limit or withdraw from a shared direction. Reading: Only the operator expresses boundaries by picking refusals and visitor gestures, while the world enforces effects and absence without its own negotiable position. Other levels: The case for below is no boundary at all and for above both sides stating limits; evidence of the world refusing or renegotiating a proposal on declared terms would falsify this reading.

judgments.verdict: Refusals appear as operator-chosen menu items and validation errors, without any second position able to limit or withdraw.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether each side can accept, limit or withdraw so shared change needs agreement. Reading: The artefact represents boundaries only as the operator's chosen refusal plus invalid-id rejection; neither Sol nor engine can question, limit or exit the operator's direction. Other levels: Below level-1 (level-0) would lack even menu refusal; above (level-2) would need Sol or engine to express a boundary from its own disposition; evidence of such bilateral refusal would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Bounded ask, respond and tick choices produce persisted stat, station, weather and receipt shifts that shape the next move.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a contribution meet resistance, expose consequence and return it into next choice. Reading: Tend, response and pulse yield inspectable effects and strain, but rehearsal still commits a receipt with no pre-commit trial. Other levels: Level-3 would need rehearsal-resistance-revision without commit and level-1 would be decorative; non-persisted or unreadable effects would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Choices meet inspectable stat shifts, weather and receipts that persist into later cycles, yet no rehearsal revises a proposal before it commits.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a contribution meet resistance, expose consequence and feed that consequence into the next choice. Reading: Bounded tendings produce inspectable deltas, station shifts, weather and receipts that persist, but rehearsal is a one-shot visitor response without revision of the same proposal. Other levels: The case for below is decorative feedback only and for above a full rehearsal-resistance-revision loop; an iterative rehearsal revising a tending before commitment would falsify this reading.

judgments.verdict: Tendings change stats, stations, weather and receipts that later ticks and visits read, but rehearsal stays a narrated effect.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a contribution can meet resistance, show consequence and return it into the next choice. Reading: Bounded tend and respond choices produce inspectable deltas, integrity drift and weather that condition later moves, yet rehearsal is a canned outcome rather than trying futures before committing. Other levels: Below (level-1) would be merely narrated feedback; above (level-3) would need pre-commit rehearsal plus revision of the same direction; finding try-before-commit with inspectable revision would falsify.

judgments.verdict: A local stdlib-only world with atomic locked persistence, deterministic randomness, CLI-before-UI and explicit unfinished limits shows coherent scope.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks grounded medium, scope and next steps with additions legible. Reading: Local persistence, pulse, widen-not-delete schema rule and built versus unfinished lists give a source-grounded rationale for workbench over monument. Other levels: Level-2 would be relevant direction only and level-4 would need weighed alternatives opening a new direction; network deps or game-over would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Building a local workbench with laws, tests and explicit horizons instead of a monument shows a reasoned, source-grounded direction.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium, scope and next steps that make additions legible. Reading: The local Ruby workbench, CLI parity, laws, tests and honest unfinished list show a coherent decision against monument for answerability with explicit horizons. Other levels: The case for below is a relevant direction without rationale and for above explicit weighed alternatives; records of rejected media or scope with reasons would falsify toward the higher claim.

judgments.verdict: Local stdlib-only persistence, pulse, tests and explicit unfinished horizons show a coherent choice to keep the world continuable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium and scope that serve touch rather than spectacle. Reading: Keeping Ruby stdlib, file lock, CLI parity, pulse and tests serves answerability, and the honestly-unfinished list makes limits legible. Other levels: Below (level-2) would be a relevant direction without such rationale; above (level-4) would keep explicit alternatives and their costs while opening a new direction; finding unexamined spectacle or hidden scope would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Gesture vocabulary becomes catalogs, stations, effects and receipts, while bilateral grammar narrows to single-operator selection and scripted answers.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives or narrows when conjecture becomes artefacts. Reading: Several relations become structure, but shared acceptance is lost as world never holds its own invariant or refusal. Other levels: Level-3 would need joint change traceable in behaviour and level-1 would be words only; a world-held boundary would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Core gestures become stations, effects, rehearsals and receipts with clear behaviour, narrowed to single-operator use with companion deferred.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what of its relations survives transformation into artefacts and what is narrowed or added. Reading: Question-probe, limit-beam, bridge-span, wall-boundary, garden-rehearsal and archive-receipt remain traceable in structure and behaviour despite collapse to single-operator menus. Other levels: The case for below is vocabulary without structure and for above explicit acknowledgement of narrowing; a statement owning the loss of bilateral grammar would falsify toward the higher claim.

judgments.verdict: Stations, tend grammar, Sol and workbench carry several seed relations into structure, narrowed to single-operator use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives as structure versus vocabulary when conjecture becomes artefact. Reading: Probe, beam, span, boundary, rehearsal and receipt become stations and enforced tend fields with consequences, though bilateral meeting narrows to operator menus. Other levels: Below (level-2) would be names without enforced grammar; above (level-4) would make the narrowing and added chain-pulse-memory explicit as choices; an acknowledged account of lost mutuality would falsify the cap.

judgments.verdict: Persisted state, ledger, folios, verify and export plus Sol waiting give a legible next move that keeps earlier work intact.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a successor recover intention and redirect while keeping work legible. Reading: Status, chronicle, memory and Sol patience plus widen-not-delete and fork-on-break rules support a recoverable move with open question. Other levels: Level-2 would be narrow durability and level-4 would need several directions reopening joint relation, limited by single world and no import; rewritable events would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Persisted state, chained archive, folios, protocols and Sol's unanswered question let the next hand read the past and choose a new tending.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a successor recover intention and change direction while keeping earlier work legible. Reading: State files, ledger, folios, continuity protocol, verify, export and Sol waiting with an open receipt question give a recoverable next move. Other levels: The case for below is a described step without usable entry and for above several directions reopening the joint relation; import, multi-world forks or a negotiable companion role would falsify toward the higher claim.

judgments.verdict: Status, chronicle, verify, export, memory and Sol waiting give a successor a legible present and an open next move.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a successor can recover intention and redirect while keeping earlier work legible. Reading: The handoff preserves events, head receipt, folios and an unanswered Sol and invites one careful change with tests, widening not erasing. Other levels: Below (level-2) would be durable but narrow replay; above (level-4) would support several grounded redirections that reopen the joint relation; showing only single-track tendings without re-openable relation keeps it below that.

judgments.verdict: Spare workbench prose, station atlas sized by charge and integrity, tactile form and receipt chronicle together make touch perceptible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks language, structure and interaction together express resistance and visible trail. Reading: Atlas, visitor gestures, answer deltas and chronicle cohere with CLI parity and reduced-motion care. Other levels: Level-2 would be fragments only and level-4 would need a fully accessible whole; file-only fallback gap and uninspected paint limit it.

judgments.verdict: Spare prose, stations, forms, chronicle and atlas together make resistance and trace legible, with interaction carrying consequence beyond decoration.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that language, structure, interaction and image together make touchable consequence perceptible. Reading: Workbench prose, stations, tactile form, visitor gestures, chronicle and atlas cohere around resistance and trace, though the canvas visualises without changing state. Other levels: The case for below is fragmented communication and for above a fully consequential accessible whole; atlas gestures that alter material would falsify toward the higher claim.

judgments.verdict: Atlas, tactile question forge, visitor edge, chronicle and quiet prose work together as a legible workbench for holding questions.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms that make touchable questioning perceptible, not merely named. Reading: Language, station tabs, canvas atlas with resistance cues and receipt chronicle cohere into a usable workbench rhythm. Other levels: Below (level-2) would be fragments without interaction; above (level-4) would need proven accessible whole including live paint and socket checks, still listed as untested; passing those checks would falsify the cap.

presentation.title: From conjecture to continuation
presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: A single operator acts on an instrument.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Bounded choices encounter inspectable consequences.
Independent judgment: Medium, scope and choices have a coherent source-grounded rationale.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible.
